title: Puzzle 3D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 3D in the React renderer: GLB coordinate frame, hover/select/gumball/marquee protocol, scene layers (vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview), and Select/Brush/Fill window engagements.
summary:
Brought the Puzzle 3D React renderer to full premigration-app parity (user chose the "everything" scope over the trimmed core-editor option), across 12 phases plus a foundations/bug-fix pass:

- Phase 0: fixed mesh-clobbering in sync_precompute_session, fixed hostRules disabling Nakagin brush rules, wired the Nakagin example, added the puzzle-3d-react-dev launch.json entry (port 6013).
- Phase 1: LOD/Select/Brush window_measures toolbar groups.
- Phase 2: kinds catalogue from meta.kindCatalogs with draggable rows and hover highlight.
- Phase 3: hierarchy panel (Objects/References/TargetVolumes/Attractions) with hide/lock.
- Phase 4: generic patchInspector-driven inspector with mixed-value placeholders.
- Phase 5: selectAll/clearSelection/focusSelection/engagement command line + keybindings.
- Phase 6: undo/redo via a snapshot-stack (not the shared vcs crate, since dispatch already used early-return style).
- Phase 7: Settings panel tab (selection mode, overlap budget, proximity radius, chunk size, grid factor).
- Phase 8: attraction connect-drag gesture in world-3d-host.tsx.
- Phase 9: voxel target-volume editing (Alt-click placement, W/D/H steppers, edit-mode toggle).
- Phase 10: OBJ/GLB mesh export baking real per-object transforms via a module-level mesh registry.
- Phase 11: Jack panel tab with a minimal self-contained MATCH/RETURN query evaluator (scoped down from a full second window per CLAUDE.md's no-mixing-technologies rule, since trinity-jack/trinity-ram weren't usable as a cross-tech dependency).
- Phase 12: camera view presets (Perspective/Top/Front/Right) + projection switch.

During final live-browser verification, found and fixed two real bugs that unit tests alone hadn't caught: (1) the View preset Select showed a hardcoded "perspective" value that never reflected the actual camera state — added a `runtime.view_preset` field wired through setCameraViewPreset; (2) the Fill engagement's "Edit Volumes" mode toggle was only rendered once already in edit-volumes mode, making it unreachable from the UI — split into an always-visible mode ToggleGroup plus conditionally-visible W/D/H steppers. Both are covered by new regression tests.

Verified live in the browser: Concrete Forest and Nakagin examples load, Objects/References/TargetVolumes tree, Inspector (Id/Label/Kind/Origin) updates on selection, Jack panel query + result-row-click selects the object in the viewport with gumball, Fill/Brush/Select engagement switching, View/LOD/Select/Brush measures render. Flagged one open item as a separate background task (not fixed here, out of scope): clicks on Select/ToggleGroup-kind controls didn't visibly commit during automated browser testing despite confirmed DOM event delivery — this is shared os-shell.tsx/ui-kit dispatch code affecting every plugin, not puzzle-3d-specific, and needs a fresh look with real mouse interaction to rule out an automation artifact.

Final state: 81 Rust tests passing (`cargo test -p puzzle-plugin --lib d3::`), 71 React tests passing (`bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react:test`).
